questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully centered in the frame (approx 00:07-00:11), exactly three pens are visible in a row.
All three pens are oriented vertically with the cap end pointing downwards, maintaining identical alignment throughout the clip.
All three pens share the same dark barrel and cap color, appearing identical to one another.
Every pen has a cap on the bottom end; no bare writing tips are exposed, and all pens appear to be the same length.
The board moves continuously and smoothly from the left side of the frame to the right side without stopping or pausing.
The pens remain fixed in their slots/positions on the white board and do not shift or slide relative to it.

parsed.reason: The board carries exactly three identical pens, all oriented correctly and capped, moving smoothly from left to right without interruption.

description: Three identical pens moving left to right on the board, smooth continuous motion.
